steps.text: I have the lessons outlined but nothing recorded
Teacher: you are not an expert
Launch my online course by March
People will laugh at my videos
I will spend the money and sell nothing
My family will see me fail

insights: Obstacles: these are things people said that you believe. They stand between you and your goal and don’t let you move forward.
The obstacle closest to you is “Dad: nobody pays for courses”. The Ladder works only with what stands between you and your goal, starting from the nearest step.
Fears: everything above the goal is what you are afraid to come close to once you reach it.
Fears above your goal: 3. Perhaps moving toward the goal is hard because it means coming closer to them.
questions: Whose voice do you hear in “Dad: nobody pays for courses”? Who said it first?
What would you do in the next 24 hours if you stopped believing it?

fullDiagnostic.text: This is a short self-check. The full free diagnostic on the site adds the steps of the past, a pause and the question “What has become clear?”. No sign-in needed.

structuredContent.author: Aizhan Li, author of the Ladder method.
structuredContent.disclaimer: The Ladder is a tool for self-discovery. It does not replace psychotherapy or medical care. If you are struggling or something hurts, please see a doctor or a psychologist in person.
